maria_g: Heads-up — partner sent late hourly batches that overlap previous windows and we're seeing 'shadow' credits show up in the marketplace ledger. Need quick mitigation and a replay plan. pinging @ajay_s @casey_k @olivia_fin :warning:

ajay_s: Can you paste one sample payload so I can check whether these are true duplicates (same usage_id) or same time ranges with different ids?

maria_g: sample below from partner webhook (they stripped PII):
```
{
  "customer_id": "ACME-123",
  "start": "2026-03-22T10:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-22T11:00:00Z",
  "units": 120,
  "sku": "redwood.gen.large",
  "source_batch": "batch_20260322_10",
  "fingerprint": "sha256:abcd1234",
  "usage_id": "u_987654"
}
```

casey_k: looks like partner replays the same source_batch with a changed `fingerprint` and sometimes a different `usage_id`. our aggregator dedupes on `fingerprint`, so when they change it a second time we accept as new.

olivia_fin: what is exposure so far? do we pause ingestion for that partner until we have a fix?

maria_g: rough estimate = ~$1.2k overstated credits across last 6 hours. recommend a soft-hold on partner webhook while we run dedupe/backfill; we should avoid immediate refunds until we validate.

ajay_s: I can push a short-lived change to dedupe key to (customer_id, start, end, sku) and ignore fingerprint for 24h. tradeoff: we'll lose some partner-intended corrections but reduce dupes. need product sign-off and an operator to run backfill.

casey_k: :thumbsup: add a 10m ingest-window buffer too so late arrivals merge into prior bucket instead of creating a new row. that should cut noise.

maria_g: Proposed steps:
1) Pause partner webhooks (soft-hold)
2) Deploy temporary dedupe key change (Ajay)
3) Run backfill/dedupe SQL job to mark duplicates and emit corrections
4) Reconcile with partner and apply credits/refunds if validated

SQL sketch (Ajay / Casey to run):
```sql
-- mark duplicates by time-range + sku + customer
with ranked as (
  select *, row_number() over (partition by customer_id, start, end, sku order by ingestion_time asc) as rn
  from marketplace_raw_usage
  where partner = 'partner-x' and ingestion_time >= '2026-03-22'
)
update marketplace_usage set status='duplicate'
from ranked where marketplace_usage.raw_id = ranked.raw_id and ranked.rn > 1;
```

casey_k: I'm starting the backfill now -> job-id: backfill-20260322-01. will stream progress here.

ingest-bot: replay job backfill-20260322-01 started, 0/1200 processed.

olivia_fin: tag me when you have a post-dedupe delta. if final > $5k we need legal loop-in per policy.

maria_g: note: partner wants to publish joint announcement next week. can we resolve before that? partners-team — please hold announcement until we confirm ledger is clean.

partners-team: acknowledged — pausing PR and marketing assets until we get the reconciliation green. :white_check_mark:

ajay_s: I'll queue the deploy in the next 20m and roll back if we see false positives. will post deploy id here.

casey_k: backfill reported ~1,180 candidate duplicates after 45m. starting validation sampling.

maria_g: thanks all. next updates here — tagging @olivia_fin for finance recon and @partners-team for announcement hold.
